QuestInfo.name: [Glory] Basic Mission: Unstable Barrier
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bBasic Mission: Unstable Barrier#k#n

#eMission Period#n
12/04/2019 12:00 AM - 12/17/2019 11:59 PM UTC

#b#eEvent Details#n#k
A spatial distortion has formed in the skies of Maple World and Grandis.
In this strange region or 'Unstable Barrier,' two kinds of volatile crystallized energy float about, ready to explode at a moment's notice.

To protect the world and eliminate these rogue energies, someone's going to have to board an airship and fly into the Unstable Barrier...

Board Checky's airship, enter the Unstable Barrier, eliminate the crystallized energy, and close the spatial distortion!
